messages:
kevin: Heads-up: were introducing a small dedicated footprint for a new inference GPU class in US-CENTRAL: mi500 (64GB, optimized for long-context mixed precision). Soft launch target: Mon Jul 21 03:00 UTC.
kevin: Pools will show as `mi500-us-central-primary` and `mi500-us-central-burst`. Initial capacity: 40 nodes across 3 AZs (24/8/8 split).
maya: Sequence: us-central-1a -> 1b -> 1c, ~12h stagger. Partner preview booked for Sun Jul 20 20:00-23:00 UTC in 1a.
ops-bot: NOTE: rolling infra changes only; no tenant VM reboots expected. Debug sampling turned on (5%) for first 48h.
kevin: Important operational note: mi500 is inference-only. Were gating training via quota during rollout. Please coordinate if you have any near-term infra tests.
sre-lead: Telemetry to monitor: token-level P50/P95, KV cache hit-rate, GPU memory fragmentation, and early driver OOMs. Well enable additional preempt alerts for the first 72 hours.
maya: Routing behavior: new allocations will prefer mi500 when available. Customers pinned to older SKUs remain routed to their pools unless they request migration. We will not auto-migrate existing reservations.
billing-bot: Billing: mi500-dedicated set as preview SKU. Any customers who migrate during preview get prorated credits; final pricing after 2-week bake.
kevin: Internal migration snippet for Console/rwctl:
```
rwctl pools create --region us-central --gpu mi500 --count 12 --pool-name mi500-us-central-primary
rwctl reservations migrate --from-pool legacy-us-central --to-pool mi500-us-central-primary --customer <id>
```
support-bot: Support playbook: tag infra tickets `mi500-rollout`. Escalation path: @support -> @sre-lead -> @kevin. Canned reply prepared for customer queries about latency and quotas.
kevin: Partner preview customers: two analytics partners + one NLP SaaS. If preview looks stable, full zone rollout for 1a begins Mon Jul 21 03:00 UTC.
sre-lead: Ops rollback plan: nodes provisioned with `mi500-preview` tag during partner window for quick drain/rollback. Watch for blue-green drift in kernel versions; well pin kernels for 48h after each zone.
maya: Note for product teams: please avoid shipping new features that depend on dedicated pools in US-CENTRAL during the rollout window.
kevin: Ill publish a short perf summary (token-level P95 and cost delta vs. mi400) after the first zone is live. Ping me if you need a customer whitelist for early access.
ops-bot: SCHEDULED: mi500 US-CENTRAL soft launch starting 2050068000. Maintenance windows per zone: 2050068000-2050154399.
maya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
